title: Microsoft brings its fourth Indian cloud region online in Hyderabad, the first delivery against a $17.5 billion commitment
excerpt: Microsoft's India South Central region in Hyderabad is live with three availability zones, zero-water cooling, and 1,000+ MW of renewable power contracts.
content_html:
TL;DR

Microsoft’s Hyderabad cloud region is live. Three availability zones, zero-water cooling, 1,000+ MW renewable power. First delivery against $17.5B India commitment. Joins Pune, Chennai, Mumbai. Claims biggest hyperscale footprint in India.

Microsoft has brought its fourth Indian cloud region online in Hyderabad, declaring general availability of India South Central on August 6. The three-availability-zone build is the largest hyperscale region Microsoft operates in the country and, by the company’s count, gives it the biggest hyperscale cloud footprint of any provider in India. The region joins existing sites in Pune, Chennai, and Mumbai, plus two data centres operated with Jio. It arrived on schedule after Microsoft described it in December 2025 as spanning an area roughly equivalent to two Eden Gardens stadiums.

The region is the first concrete capacity delivery against the $17.5 billion India commitment Microsoft announced in December 2025, its largest investment in Asia. That four-year programme, covering 2026 through 2029, followed a $3 billion commitment made in January 2025, bringing total pledged India spending to $20.5 billion. Early customers are concentrated in regulated industries: HDFC Bank plans to use Hyderabad as a disaster-recovery region, and Bajaj Finance, payments company PB Pay, and Adani Digital Lab are also named. Financial services is where India’s data-residency requirements are strictest.

The physical build tells the more interesting story. The cooling system uses air-cooled chillers that consume no water, part of the zero-water design Microsoft announced in 2024 for its new data centre generation. On power, Microsoft has been building India infrastructure aggressively, signing multi-year power purchase agreements tied to more than 1,000 MW of new solar, wind, and hybrid projects, with over 630 MW already operating. Microsoft disclosed in February that it matched 100% of its annual global electricity consumption with renewable energy purchases across roughly 40 GW of contracted clean power in 26 countries.

One caveat sits inside the announcement: eligible Microsoft Cloud services run from Hyderabad at general availability, with further services arriving over time. A region going live and every Azure and Microsoft 365 workload being available in it are two different milestones. IDC forecasts India public cloud spending reaching $45.7 billion by 2030, growing at 22% annually, with AI spending expanding at roughly twice that rate. India’s data centre market is drawing a queue of hyperscale commitments, and Microsoft is converting pledges into concrete faster than most.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

微软的海得拉巴云区域已上线。 三个可用区、零水冷却、1,000+ MW 可再生能源。 印度承诺首次交付 $17.5B。 加入浦那、钦奈、孟买。 声称拥有印度最大的超大规模足迹。

微软在海得拉巴上线了第四个印度云区域，并宣布印度中南云区域于 8 月 6 日全面上线。 三个可用区的构建是微软在印度运营的最大的超大规模区域，根据该公司的统计，它是印度所有提供商中最大的超大规模云足迹。 该地区还包括浦那、钦奈和孟买的现有站点，以及 Jio 运营的两个数据中心。 微软在 2025 年 12 月将其描述为跨越了大约相当于两个伊甸花园体育场的区域后，它如期抵达。

该地区是微软在 2025 年 12 月宣布的 175 亿美元印度承诺中首次具体交付产能，这是微软在亚洲最大的投资。 这项为期四年的计划涵盖 2026 年至 2029 年，此前在 2025 年 1 月做出了 30 亿美元的承诺，使印度承诺的支出总额达到 205 亿美元。 早期客户集中在受监管行业：HDFC 银行计划将海得拉巴作为灾难恢复区域，Bajaj Finance、支付公司 PB Pay 和 Adani Digital Lab 也被点名。 金融服务是印度数据驻留要求最严格的领域。

物理构造讲述了更有趣的故事。 该冷却系统采用不耗水的风冷式冷水机，这是微软于 2024 年宣布的新一代数据中心零水设计的一部分。 在电力方面，微软一直在积极建设印度基础设施，签署了与超过 1,000 兆瓦的新太阳能、风能和混合动力项目相关的多年期购电协议，其中超过 630 兆瓦已经投入运行。 微软在 2 月份透露，该公司在 26 个国家购买了约 40 吉瓦的可再生能源，以满足其全球年度用电量的 100%。

公告中包含一个警告：符合条件的 Microsoft 云服务将在海得拉巴全面运行，随着时间的推移，还会提供更多服务。 区域上线以及其中可用的每个 Azure 和 Microsoft 365 工作负载是两个不同的里程碑。 IDC 预测，到 2030 年，印度公共云支出将达到 457 亿美元，年增长率为 22%，其中人工智能支出的增长速度约为该速度的两倍。 印度的数据中心市场正在吸引一系列超大规模的承诺，而微软正在比大多数公司更快地将承诺转化为具体的承诺。
